explanations: renderTrack() applies the downgrades in CHANGES order, oldest first, but each downgrade expects the shape produced by the version that introduced it. To reach 2024-01-10 from the latest shape you must undo 2025-09-15 (artists to artistName) before undoing 2025-03-01 (artistName to artist). Running them oldest first undoes the rename while artistName doesn't exist yet, which sets artist to undefined, and then produces an artistName the client doesn't know. Clients only one change behind never notice, because a single downgrade can't be misordered. The fix walks the changes newest first, so each conversion sees the shape it was written for.
